headlines.title: General Motors Plans 20% Increase in Factory Automation by 2028 as Manufacturing Costs Rise
headlines.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) is planning to increase the use of robotics and other automated technologies across its North American manufacturing facilities by 20% by 2028, according to a Reuters report citing two people familiar with the company’s plans. The initiative comes as the US automaker seeks to manage higher labour expenses and costs associated with expanding domestic manufacturing operations.

headlines.title: ‘A complete reversal’: China once feared becoming roadkill for Western automakers, but a quarter-century after joining the WTO, the tables have turned
headlines.summary: Long before Europe worried about Chinese cars flooding its markets, China worried Europe would destroy its auto industry.

headlines.title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for General Motors Stock?
headlines.summary: General Motors has outperformed the broader market, supported by earnings growth, raised cash flow guidance, buybacks, and increasingly bullish analyst sentiment.

headlines.title: What Does General Motors (GM) $550 Million Solar Push Signal For Investors?
headlines.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) announced a US$550 million commitment to large-scale solar projects to offset emissions from its factories. The new clean-energy program is described by GM as its largest single investment focused on lowering manufacturing-related emissions to date. Management plans to source power from multiple utility-scale solar facilities, aiming to match a sizeable share of plant electricity demand.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Stock Could Be Cheap On Its 216% Three Year Run
headlines.summary: General Motors has delivered a powerful share price run over the past few years, which puts fresh attention on whether the current quote lines up with the cash flows investors are paying for. With the stock now reflecting both core auto operations and newer electric vehicle related projects, the key issue is how those pieces translate into an intrinsic value based on its cash generation.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
